steps.en: After the third letter, the hirer's notice becomes due for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Setelah surat ketiga, notice hirer menjadi kandidat pengingat elektronik

steps.en: OCMS rechecks the individual hirer's latest mobile number
steps.id: OCMS mengecek ulang nomor mobile terbaru hirer individu
steps.why_en: The recheck of the newest number is switched off by a setting, so only the number already on file is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan nomor terbaru dimatikan oleh satu setting, jadi hanya nomor yang sudah tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: OCMS rechecks the company hirer's latest email address
steps.id: OCMS mengecek ulang alamat email terbaru hirer company
steps.why_en: The recheck of the newest email is switched off by a setting, so only the email already on file is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan email terbaru dimatikan oleh satu setting, jadi hanya email yang sudah tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: The newest contact details are saved on the hirer's record
steps.id: Kontak terbaru disimpan di data hirer pada notice
steps.why_en: Saving only happens after a recheck, and the recheck is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan hanya terjadi setelah pengecekan ulang, dan pengecekan itu dimatikan di setting produksi.

steps.en: A reminder is prepared only when a valid phone or email exists
steps.id: Pengingat hanya disiapkan kalau ada nomor telepon atau email yang valid
